// Router fixture for verb-no-gate-exit.cts.txt: the `verify` router's dispatch table, as the guard
// discovers it (`verify.<fn>` calls inside `routeVerifyCommand`).
interface VerifyModule {
  cmdFixtureVerb(raw: boolean): void;
}

export function routeVerifyCommand({ verify, raw }: { verify: VerifyModule; raw: boolean }): void {
  const handlers = {
    fixture: () => verify.cmdFixtureVerb(raw),
  };
  void handlers;
}
